geometry_edits: Rebuilt the structural shell on the official 56-vertex campus GIS footprint and kept the assigned object, collection, scene, ID, and asset path stable.

Added procedurally textured red-brown brick, limestone plinth/cornices/window surrounds, divided-light windows, and Tudor timber gable details. Window spacing and exact facade pattern remain inferred.

Added three longer clay-tile gable runs aligned with the GIS U-plan wings and a darker, subtly mottled EPDM field to make the documented roof-system zones visually distinct. Copper edging marks roof transitions; exact roof extents and form remain interpretive.

Added a courtyard-facing entrance candidate with limestone surround, glazed double doors, a gabled canopy, and a layered heraldic lion-and-shield relief on the canopy face. Purdue Archives supports the motif, but the entrance location, plaque placement, and sculptural geometry are explicitly estimated because no measured elevation was found.

Added representative room modules on upper residential levels using public Windsor single/double layout diagrams, with bed, desk, chair, dresser and reading-device details. A roof-open, locally cropped cutaway preview uses stronger temporary preview-only contrast and lighting; the saved library materials remain procedural. Added a schematic ground-floor lobby and study fit-out from the renovation writeup. These are examples, not a claimed Shealy floor plan.
